# Arkiv schema

<!-- Generated by `pnpm arkiv:schema` from src/arkiv/kinds.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Lanyard stores everything people do as Arkiv entities on **Rabdi** (chain `7794095`). Every
record is written by the actor's own wallet, carries the four common indexed attributes below,
and is untagged (no `arkiv.schema` attribute): readers filter on `app`, `event` and `kind`.
Owners can patch only mutable records; readonly records can still be deleted or transferred by
their owner, so the freeze operator retains captured evidence. Retention is physical expiry,
never a business deadline.

## Common attributes

| Attribute  | Type | Indexed | Meaning                                                                                                      |
| ---------- | ---- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `app`      | str  | yes     | Always `lanyard`                                                                                             |
| `event`    | str  | yes     | The edition, e.g. `mumbai2026`                                                                               |
| `kind`     | str  | yes     | One of the kinds below                                                                                       |
| `by_label` | str  | yes     | The writer's relative ENS label (`priya.volunteers`) or authority persona (`organizer`); Arkiv reserves `by` |

## Kinds

| Kind                  | Written by                                                                        | Flags                              | Retention                                   | Meaning                                                                                       |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `venue`               | organizer                                                                         | readonly                           | event end + 30 days                         | A published venue.json (grid, seats, POIs, zones), one record per version                     |
| `seat_assignment`     | organizer                                                                         | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | Which seat a hacker sits in, by wallet address and `hackers` badge label                      |
| `shift`               | lead                                                                              | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | A volunteer's shift in a zone; a change is a new shift that supersedes the old one            |
| `clock`               | lead, or the volunteer for a self clock-in                                        | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | Clock `in`/`out` for one shift; effective time is the block time, `stated_at` is display only |
| `duty_pass`           | lead                                                                              | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | Display evidence of a lead clock-in, with the logical shift-end deadline                      |
| `ticket`              | hacker                                                                            | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | A help request from a seat; logical lifetime 4 h from creation                                |
| `ticket_claim`        | on-duty volunteer, or that partner's staff for partner tickets                    | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | A claim on a ticket; the earliest eligible claim holds a 15-minute logical lease              |
| `ticket_resolution`   | the winning claim's helper                                                        | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | Resolution bound to the winning claim; it stays valid after the lease ends                    |
| `ticket_confirmation` | the ticket's hacker                                                               | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | The hacker confirms a resolution; nothing is mutated                                          |
| `project`             | team lead                                                                         | mutable                            | results + 30 days                           | Editable project draft (team-page content); never judging evidence                            |
| `submission`          | team lead                                                                         | readonly + permissionlessExtension | maximum (≈182.5 days, extendable by anyone) | Immutable snapshot of the project, team, track and lead address, bound by `content_hash`      |
| `acceptance`          | organizer                                                                         | readonly                           | results + 30 days                           | The organizer accepts a submission into a track                                               |
| `rubric`              | organizer (any track; the only writer for `main`), or a partner for its own track | readonly                           | results + 30 days                           | A track's criteria, weights and scale; the earliest valid one before the deadline is frozen   |
| `judge_assignment`    | organizer, a partner for its track, or the head judge for `main`                  | readonly                           | results + 30 days                           | Assigns a judge to a submission under a rubric                                                |
| `score_sheet`         | judge                                                                             | mutable                            | judging end + 2 days                        | Encrypted mirror of a device-local editable draft                                             |
| `final_score`         | judge                                                                             | readonly                           | results + 30 days                           | Sealed final score: authenticated ciphertext, opened only at freeze                           |
| `recusal`             | the target judge (self only), or the organizer                                    | readonly                           | results + 30 days                           | Removes one judge from one submission                                                         |
| `results`             | results key                                                                       | readonly + permissionlessExtension | maximum (≈182.5 days, extendable by anyone) | Compact rankings, results/bundle/config hashes, bundle URI, signature, cutoffs, rule version  |
| `drip`                | desk wallet (desk-wallet funding profile)                                         | readonly                           | event end + 7 days                          | One first-time tGLM send; the desk refuses a second send to the same address                  |

## Querying

Queries are current-state equality filters on indexed columns, ordered by key, at most 100 rows
per page; the node rejects `!=`, so status is modeled positively (e.g. a ticket is closed by a
`ticket_resolution`, never by filtering `status != open`). Example: every help ticket of the
edition, with the pinned SDK:

```ts
import { createPublicClient } from "@arkiv-network/sdk";
import { rabdi } from "@arkiv-network/sdk/chains";
import { and, asc, eq } from "@arkiv-network/sdk/query";
import { http } from "viem";

const client = createPublicClient({ chain: rabdi({ accessKey: "" }), transport: http() });
const page = await client
  .select({ $key: true, $creator: true, $createdAt: true, $attributes: true })
  .where(and(eq("app", "lanyard"), eq("event", "mumbai2026"), eq("kind", "ticket")))
  .orderBy(asc("$key"))
  .limit(100)
  .fetch();
```
